ได้ข้อมูลครบแล้ว ให้สรุประบบ Supplier Portal / Vendor Portal ทั้งหมดของ Monolith:

Supplier Portal (Vendor Portal) — ระบบ Monolith

ใน Monolith ไม่มี "พอร์ทัล" แบบเว็บไซต์แยกให้ Supplier เข้าล็อกอิน แต่ถูกออกแบบเป็น backend-first vendor management ที่ฝังอยู่ใน Capture Spine และ Field Purchase — ทุกอย่างทำงานผ่าน LINE + หลังบ้านอัตโนมัติ

ภาพรวม: 3 ชั้นของระบบ Vendor/Supplier
ช่างหน้างาน (LINE)       หลังบ้าน (Capture Spine)       บัญชี/การเงิน
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ถ่ายรูป + จำนวน  ──→  field_purchase_request     vendor_master
                          ↓                         (match tax_id หลัก
ถ่ายใบเสร็จ     ──→  expense_document  ──────────  ชื่อรอง / unverified)
                          ↓                              ↓
                     auto-match คำขอ↔ใบเสร็จ     ledger + job cost

1. Vendor Master — ฐานข้อมูลผู้ขาย

ตาราง: vendor_master (migration 0064)

Column	Type	หมายเหตุ
vendor_code	text PK	รหัสผู้ขาย
name	text	ชื่อผู้ขาย
tax_id	text	เลขผู้เสียภาษี 13 หลัก (unique index)
address	text	ที่อยู่
active	boolean	สถานะใช้งาน

กฎสำคัญ:

เขียนเข้าได้ผ่าน rpc_upsert_vendor() เท่านั้น (governance role)
อ่านได้ทุก authenticated user
tax_id เป็น unique partial index — ห้าม auto-merge ถ้าซ้ำ ต้อง governance ตรวจเอง

ADR-028 — Logic การ match vendor ใบเสร็จ:

ใบเสร็จจาก OCR → ดึง vendor_tax_id + vendor_name
  1. มี tax_id → lookup vendor_master.tax_id (primary)
       พบ + ชื่อตรง → ✅ ผ่าน
       พบ + ชื่อไม่ตรง → ✅ ผ่าน แต่เพิ่ม fraud signal: "name_mismatch"
       ไม่พบ → mark unverified ที่ tax_id → fallback ชื่อ
  2. ไม่มี tax_id / OCR อ่านไม่ได้ → fallback ชื่อ (normalize ด้วย lower+trim)
       ไม่พบในชื่อ → mark unverified → flag บัญชีตรวจ (ไม่ block)

2. Field Purchase — กระบวนการจัดซื้อหน้างาน

สิ่งที่ช่างเห็น (2 การกระทำเท่านั้น):

ถ่ายรูปของหัก + "ดอกสว่านหัก 350" ใน LINE กลุ่ม
ถ่ายใบเสร็จส่ง LINE → จบ

สิ่งที่หลังบ้านทำ (ช่างไม่รู้เลย):

field_purchase_request
  ├── infer: บ้าน/project ← line_groups.project_id
  ├── infer: ห้อง/work_item ← subtask assignment ช่าง
  ├── infer: ผู้ขอ ← line_staff_identity
  ├── route ผู้อนุมัติตามวงเงิน:
  │     ≤ เพดาน A → หัวหน้าทีมติดตั้ง
  │     ≤ เพดาน B → ผู้จัดการโครงการ (PM)
  │     > เพดาน B → กรรมการผู้จัดการ (MD)
  └── Flex card ไปผู้อนุมัติ → กดปุ่มเดียว → HMAC verify → audit


ตารางใหม่ที่ต้อง implement:

field_purchase_request (
  id, project_id, work_item_id,
  requester (staff), amount, reason, photo_refs,
  status: pending|approved|rejected|purchased|closed,
  approver, approved_at, approval_level, created_at
)

field_purchase_thresholds (
  level, max_amount, role_key   -- เพดาน A/B config ไม่ hardcode
)

3. Auto-Match ใบเสร็จ ↔ คำขอซื้อ

เมื่อช่างส่งใบเสร็จเข้า LINE → match กับ field_purchase_request อัตโนมัติด้วย:

เงื่อนไข	รายละเอียด
ผู้ขอเดียวกัน	requester match
บ้านเดียวกัน	project_id match
ช่วงเวลา	หลังอนุมัติ ≤ N วัน
จำนวนใกล้เคียง	± tolerance (owner กำหนด)
match 1 คู่ชัด → ผูกอัตโนมัติ
หลายคู่/ไม่ชัด → บัญชีเลือกใน review queue
ใบเสร็จ > อนุมัติ + tolerance → flag ห้าม auto-ลง (No Silent Overspend)
4. Ledger Integration

เมื่อบัญชียืนยันใบเสร็จ:

ลง ledger double-entry (migration 0066_ledger_engine)
VAT + WHT ตาม capture_type_config
ผูก job cost เข้าบ้าน/work_item (ADR-027)
ตั้งเบิกคืนช่าง อัตโนมัติ
5. สถานะ Implementation
Phase	งาน	สถานะ
Vendor Master	0064_vendor_master.sql, 0076_vendor_taxid_matching.sql	✅ deploy แล้ว
Expense Document	capture type, OCR, fraud signals	✅ deploy แล้ว
Field Purchase Request	migration + capture_type + bot flow + approval routing	⬜ รอ implement
Auto-Match ใบเสร็จ↔คำขอ	D-5 logic	⬜ รอ implement
Dashboard ค้าง	Phase 3 reporting	⬜ รอ implement

Blocking decisions ก่อน implement:

 Owner ต้องกำหนดเพดาน A/B (วงเงิน บาท)
 tolerance การ match ใบเสร็จ (±กี่ % / กี่วัน)
 workflow Phase 13 (SLA escalation) ต้องปิดก่อน

Monolith Field Purchase Subsystem — Session Summary
What Was Built

A complete field purchase request (FPR) subsystem for the Monolith Manufacturing OS, integrated with LINE Bot, Supabase/PostgreSQL, and the existing ledger engine. All work follows the repo's established patterns: SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, RLS fail-closed, append-only audit, idempotent migrations, no client write path.

Deliverables (22 items across 7 requests)
Database Migrations (SQL)
File	Description
0176_field_purchase_core.sql	ENUMs, field_purchase_request, field_purchase_thresholds (3-tier seed), audit log, triggers, RLS, core RPCs
0177_field_purchase_line_flow.sql	fpr_line_session, 6 Flex Card templates, fn_line_handle_group_event, rpc_route_fpr_approval_notification, rpc_handle_fpr_postback (8 actions)
0178_vendor_master_seed.sql	16 Thai supplier upserts via rpc_upsert_vendor with vendor_code + tax_id
0179_field_purchase_cron.sql	pg_cron fpr-expire-sessions every 15 minutes
0180_field_purchase_ledger.sql	Double-entry ledger (Dr 5050 / Cr 1010) on rpc_mark_field_purchase_purchased
0181_fpr_summary_view.sql	v_field_purchase_request_summary initial version with role-gate RLS

Key Architecture Decisions
RLS: All tables fail-closed; views use security_invoker=true or explicit role-gate WHERE clause
Audit: Append-only field_purchase_audit_log; trigger fires on status change; manual entries for closed, reopened, escalated
Approval tiers: team_lead ≤ ฿3,000 → project_manager ≤ ฿10,000 → managing_director (unlimited)
Ledger: G-4 inline double-entry on purchase confirmation; journal_entry_id recorded in audit metadata
LINE: HMAC-SHA256 channel secret verification; Flex Cards served from seeded templates; DM session state stored in fpr_line_session
Cron: Two pg_cron jobs — session expiry (*/15 min) and MV refresh (hourly)
No reopen notification: Authority-gated; coordinated out-of-band (future migration can add)

Wrapped in BEGIN … EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS — notification failures are non-fatal, approval is committed regardless

Migration 0196 — rpc_retry_fpr_notifications (211 lines)
Aspect	Detail
Mechanism	UPDATE ... SET status = 'pending' on matching 'failed' rows — no new rows, existing failed rows reset for re-delivery
Eligibility guard	status='failed' + FPR status='approved' + approved_at < now() - p_older_than + has_site_access()
p_older_than minimum	1 minute — rejects sub-minute values to prevent dispatch-race re-queuing
Idempotent	Yes — status='failed' filter means already-pending rows are never double-touched
Authority	PM / MD / governance for JWT callers; service_role bypasses gate (for pg_cron)
pg_cron schedule	fpr-retry-failed-notifications, */10 * * * * — registered in same migration

Deliverable 1 — fpr_dashboard.html Escape key handler (line 1577)

(function attachKeyboardShortcuts() {
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    const openModals = document.querySelectorAll('[id$="-modal"]:not(.hidden)');
    openModals.forEach(function (modal) {
      const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('button[onclick^="close"]');
      if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click();
    });
  });
})();

Pattern is future-proof: any modal whose id ends with -modal and has a button[onclick^="close…"] is handled automatically — no per-modal wiring needed.

cd /home/sandbox TOKEN="[CREDENTIAL REDACTED]" REPO="indetailsgroup-hue/monolith-workspace" API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/contents" BRANCH="main" MSG="feat(fpr): FPR subsystem — migrations 0176-0210, edge functions, CI" push_file() { local local_path="$1" local remote_path="$2" [[ ! -f "$local_path" ]] && { echo " [SKIP] missing: $local_path"; return 0; } local content content=$(base64 -w 0 < "$local_path") local existing_sha existing_sha=$(curl -sf \ -H "Authorization: token ${TOKEN}" \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \ "${API}/${remote_path}?ref=${BRANCH}" 2>/dev/null \ | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('sha',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "") local body if [[ -n "$existing_sha" ]]; then body=$(python3 -c " import json,sys print(json.dumps({'message':sys.argv[1],'content':sys.argv[2],'sha':sys.argv[3],'branch':sys.argv[4]})) " "$MSG" "$content" "$existing_sha" "$BRANCH") echo -n " [UPD] ${remote_path} " else body=$(python3 -c " import json,sys print(json.dumps({'message':sys.argv[1],'content':sys.argv[2],'branch':sys.argv[3]})) " "$MSG" "$content" "$BRANCH") echo -n " [NEW] ${remote_path} " fi local http_status http_status=$(curl -s -o /tmp/ghresp.json -w "%{http_code}" \ -X PUT \ -H "Authorization: token ${TOKEN}" \ -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d "$body" \ "${API}/${remote_path}") if [[ "$http_status" == "200" || "$http_status" == "201" ]]; then echo "→ HTTP ${http_status} OK" else echo "→ FAILED HTTP ${http_status}" python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('/tmp/ghresp.json')); print(' Error:', d.get('message','?'))" 2>/dev/null return 1 fi } echo "=== SQL Migrations ===" for f in /home/sandbox/0[12][0-9][0-9]_*.sql; do fname=$(basename "$f") push_file "$f" "supabase/migrations/${fname}" done

cat > /home/sandbox/0215_fpr_bulk_record_payment.sql << 'SQL_EOF' -- ============================================================================= -- Migration 0215 — rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment -- -- Adds a batch payment-recording RPC that processes an array of fpr_payment -- records in a single call. Each row is handled atomically inside a sub-block: -- • idempotency_key dedup → SKIP (no error) -- • business-rule validation → per-row error object (no transaction abort) -- • successful insert → audit entry + ok=true result -- -- Depends on: 0176_field_purchase_core, 0212_fpr_vendor_payment_flow -- ============================================================================= -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- SECTION 1 — RPC rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment( p_payments JSONB -- JSON array of payment objects (see below) ) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ /* Input shape (one element of p_payments): { "request_id" : "<uuid>", -- required "payment_method" : "cash|transfer|cheque|card|other", -- required "amount" : 1500.00, -- required, > 0 "vendor_id" : "<uuid>", -- optional "payment_reference" : "REF-001", -- optional "currency" : "THB", -- optional, default THB "paid_at" : "2026-09-01T09:00:00Z", -- optional, default now() "paid_by" : "actor-id", -- optional, default resolve_actor() "idempotency_key" : "unique-client-key" -- optional; skip if already exists } Return shape: { "total" : 3, "recorded" : 2, "skipped" : 1, "errors" : 0, "results" : [ { "index": 0, "ok": true, "skipped": false, "payment_id": "<uuid>" }, { "index": 1, "ok": true, "skipped": true, "payment_id": "<uuid>", "reason": "idempotency_key already recorded" }, { "index": 2, "ok": false, "skipped": false, "error": "..." } ] } */ DECLARE v_actor text; v_idx int; v_row JSONB; v_result JSONB; v_results JSONB := '[]'::jsonb; -- per-row extracted fields v_payment_id uuid; v_request_id uuid; v_vendor_id uuid; v_payment_method text; v_payment_ref text; v_amount numeric; v_currency text; v_paid_at timestamptz; v_paid_by text; v_idem_key text; v_existing_id uuid; -- running counters v_cnt_recorded int := 0; v_cnt_skipped int := 0; v_cnt_errors int := 0; BEGIN -- ── Security gate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── IF NOT has_any_app_role(ARRAY['governance', 'finance', 'site_admin']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: finance, governance or site_admin role required' USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege'; END IF; v_actor := resolve_actor(); -- ── Input type guard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── IF p_payments IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_payments) <> 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_payments must be a non-null JSON array' USING ERRCODE = 'invalid_parameter_value'; END IF; IF jsonb_array_length(p_payments) = 0 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object( 'total', 0, 'recorded', 0, 'skipped', 0, 'errors', 0, 'results', '[]'::jsonb ); END IF; -- ── Process each payment row ─────────────────────────────────────────────── FOR v_idx IN 0 .. (jsonb_array_length(p_payments) - 1) LOOP v_row := p_payments -> v_idx; v_result := jsonb_build_object('index', v_idx, 'ok', false, 'skipped', false); <<row_block>> BEGIN -- Extract fields (with type coercions) v_request_id := (v_row ->>'request_id')::uuid; v_vendor_id := (v_row ->>'vendor_id')::uuid; v_payment_method := v_row ->>'payment_method'; v_payment_ref := v_row ->>'payment_reference'; v_amount := (v_row ->>'amount')::numeric; v_currency := COALESCE(v_row ->>'currency', 'THB'); v_paid_at := COALESCE((v_row ->>'paid_at')::timestamptz, now()); v_paid_by := COALESCE(v_row ->>'paid_by', v_actor); v_idem_key := v_row ->>'idempotency_key'; -- Required-field validation ──────────────────────────────────────────── IF v_request_id IS NULL THEN v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('error', 'request_id is required'); v_cnt_errors := v_cnt_errors + 1; EXIT row_block; END IF; IF v_payment_method IS NULL OR v_payment_method NOT IN ('cash','transfer','cheque','card','other') THEN v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('error', 'payment_method must be one of: cash, transfer, cheque, card, other'); v_cnt_errors := v_cnt_errors + 1; EXIT row_block; END IF; IF v_amount IS NULL OR v_amount <= 0 THEN v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('error', 'amount must be a positive number'); v_cnt_errors := v_cnt_errors + 1; EXIT row_block; END IF; -- Idempotency dedup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── IF v_idem_key IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT id INTO v_existing_id FROM fpr_payment WHERE idempotency_key = v_idem_key LIMIT 1; IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object( 'ok', true, 'skipped', true, 'payment_id', v_existing_id, 'reason', 'idempotency_key already recorded' ); v_cnt_skipped := v_cnt_skipped + 1; EXIT row_block; END IF; END IF; -- Business-rule: request must be in a payable state ─────────────────── IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM field_purchase_request WHERE id = v_request_id AND status IN ('approved', 'purchased', 'closed') ) THEN v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object( 'error', 'request not found or not in a payable state (approved / purchased / closed)' ); v_cnt_errors := v_cnt_errors + 1; EXIT row_block; END IF; -- Insert payment record ──────────────────────────────────────────────── v_payment_id := gen_random_uuid(); INSERT INTO fpr_payment ( id, request_id, vendor_id, payment_method, payment_reference, amount, currency, paid_at, paid_by, status, idempotency_key ) VALUES ( v_payment_id, v_request_id, v_vendor_id, v_payment_method, v_payment_ref, v_amount, v_currency, v_paid_at, v_paid_by, 'paid', v_idem_key ); -- Append-only audit entry ───────────────────────────────────────────── INSERT INTO fpr_audit_log ( request_id, action, actor, details ) VALUES ( v_request_id, 'bulk_payment_recorded', v_actor, jsonb_build_object( 'payment_id', v_payment_id, 'payment_method', v_payment_method, 'amount', v_amount, 'currency', v_currency, 'bulk_batch_index', v_idx ) ); v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object( 'ok', true, 'payment_id', v_payment_id ); v_cnt_recorded := v_cnt_recorded + 1; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN -- Surface per-row exceptions without aborting the outer transaction v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object( 'error', SQLERRM, 'sqlstate', SQLSTATE ); v_cnt_errors := v_cnt_errors + 1; END row_block; v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(v_result); END LOOP; -- ── Summary envelope ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── RETURN jsonb_build_object( 'total', jsonb_array_length(p_payments), 'recorded', v_cnt_recorded, 'skipped', v_cnt_skipped, 'errors', v_cnt_errors, 'results', v_results ); END; $$; -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- SECTION 2 — Permissions -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment(JSONB) FROM PUBLIC; -- Authenticated users can call; row-level access enforced inside via has_any_app_role GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment(JSONB) TO authenticated; -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- SECTION 3 — Comment -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- COMMENT ON FUNCTION rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment(JSONB) IS 'Batch-records fpr_payment rows from a JSON array. Each element is processed ' 'independently: idempotency_key collisions are silently skipped; validation ' 'failures and unexpected errors are captured per-row without aborting the ' 'batch. Returns a summary envelope with total/recorded/skipped/errors counts ' 'and a per-row results array. Requires finance, governance or site_admin role.'; SQL_EOF wc -l /home/sandbox/0215_fpr_bulk_record_payment.sql && echo "Migration written."

Our strategy with 0172_z was to pre-create the indexes so that IF NOT EXISTS makes them no-ops. But the critical question is: does PostgreSQL check IF NOT EXISTS before checking the "cannot run inside a transaction block" constraint?

In PostgreSQL 15, when you execute CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS inside a transaction, it checks for the index's existence first and returns early as a no-op if found, without throwing the transaction block error. This behavior requires the index to have been created in a prior committed transaction, which is exactly what 0172_z does — it creates the indexes in their own migration transaction that completes before 0173 runs.

So when 0173 starts its new transaction, those indexes should already exist and the CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS statements should be no-ops. The issue might be that the 0172_z DO blocks are adding the org_id column to the customer table first with ALTER TABLE customer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS org_id uuid, then creating the index on it.

But I'm wondering if there's something specific about how PostgreSQL handles CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS inside a PL/pgSQL DO block versus at the top level, or if there's a version-specific behavior I'm missing. PERFORM cron.unschedule('check-overdue-invoices')
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'check-overdue-invoices'

This is invalid PL/pgSQL. The fix is to wrap it in an IF statement:

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cron.job WHERE jobname = 'check-overdue-invoices') THEN
  PERFORM cron.unschedule('check-overdue-invoices');
END IF;


OR use an exception-safe approach:

BEGIN
  PERFORM cron.unschedule('check-overdue-invoices');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;

Actually, statement-level triggers in Postgres fire regardless of whether rows match, so a WHERE clause that matches zero rows would still trigger it. The real solution is to wrap the updates in a conditional block that checks if there are actually rows to update, or use SET sessionreplicationrole = replica to bypass trigger firing altogether. 0176_field_purchase_core.sql, lines 163-192:

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_fpr_audit_transition()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
    INSERT INTO field_purchase_audit_log
      (request_id, actor, event_type, old_status, new_status, metadata)
    VALUES (
      NEW.id,
      COALESCE(current_setting('app.actor', true), 'system'),
      'status_changed',
      OLD.status,
      NEW.status,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'approver',        NEW.approver,
        'approval_level',  NEW.approval_level,
        'amount',          NEW.amount,
        'rejection_note',  NEW.rejection_note,
        'approved_at',     NEW.approved_at
      )
    );
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

Summary

Root cause identified and fixed:

20261001_people_culture_schema.sql (People & Culture schema migration) re-defined get_user_org_id() and has_role_in_org() with AND status = 'ACTIVE' on org_members, but org_members has an is_active BOOLEAN column, not status TEXT. This caused a runtime column "status" does not exist (SQLSTATE 42703) whenever rpc_bulk_record_fpr_payment called get_user_org_id().

Two-line fix in 20261001_people_culture_schema.sql:

get_user_org_id(): AND status = 'ACTIVE' → AND is_active = true
has_role_in_org(): AND status = 'ACTIVE' → AND is_active = true
